data.name: Torel Avantgarde
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Accommodation

Indulge in the ultimate comfort at Torel Avantgarde, a 3-time award-winning 5-star hotel in the heart of Porto. The elegantly designed rooms feature modern amenities such as air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, and private terraces in some rooms. Enjoy panoramic views of the city while unwinding in style.

Top-Notch Facilities

Experience leisure at its finest with an outdoor swimming pool, a fitness centre, and a serene garden at your disposal. Whether you prefer a refreshing swim or a relaxing stroll amidst lush greenery, this hotel has something for everyone.

Culinary Delights

Savor the flavors of Portugal at the on-site restaurant offering a delectable mix of Portuguese and local cuisine. Start your day with a delicious continental breakfast before exploring nearby attractions like the Clérigos Church and the Lello Bookshop.

Book now to elevate your Porto experience at Torel Avantgarde.
